supporting_observations.claim: Repeated svc-docsync authentication failures began at 13:33:47 and continued through 13:48:48. The FILE-MAP-01 failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals, matching the inventory description of DocSync re-authenticating each run.

The failures identify FILE-MAP-01 as the workstation and report bad-password status (SubStatus 0xc000006a); corresponding domain-controller records also show failed password validation or Kerberos pre-authentication.

The failure pattern starts shortly after the scheduled 13:30 UTC svc-docsync password rotation. Together with the known per-minute DocSync runs and the FILE-MAP-01 attribution, this is consistent with the job continuing to use a stale password until manually updated, rather than evidence of a password-guessing source.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for PROXY-MAP-01 were not collected during 13:20–14:20 UTC because of a collection outage; this limits visibility into proxy activity in that window but does not explain the host-attributed authentication failures.
The supplied evidence does not establish whether the password rotation was completed or when the DocSync job was updated.
claims_not_established: Whether any svc-docsync authentication succeeded during the review window.

additional_evidence_needed: For operational confirmation, verify the password-rotation record and DocSync job update time, and confirm the job resumed successful authentication after the update.
unrelated_findings: At 13:21:41 UTC, WS-AHASSAN-01 recorded an explicit-credentials event targeting svc-docsync on DC-MAP-01 from a SYSTEM context with Commvault GxCVD.exe as the named process. The event alone does not establish success or maliciousness; review this separately because the supplied inventory does not explain this use. Record: T172-00001.
